log.title: Born in Cedar Bay
log.body: Your guardian, Jo, works as a costume maker. Jo sews a crooked felt star onto the first blanket you ever own.

log.title: The music box
log.body: Kick to the tune. Your heels keep terrible time. Jo plays the song twice anyway.

log.title: The button tin
log.body: Sort them by color. You invent a category for buttons that look almost, but not quite, like the moon.

log.title: An indoor rainbow
log.body: Paint the paper. Your first painting goes up on the fridge. Jo calls the blue blob a whale.

log.title: A very good puddle
log.body: Jump in with both feet. You come home with wet socks and a wildly inaccurate story about a tidal wave.

log.title: A small moment
log.body: Someone puts soft socks on you. You make a dedicated effort to remove them.

log.title: The other half
log.body: Share your apple slices. By lunch you have a trade agreement. By Friday you have a best friend.

log.title: The empty chair
log.body: Pull up a chair. They have a collection of jokes so bad the whole table wants another.

log.title: A small moment
log.body: The library card with your name on it feels more official than a passport.

log.title: Three crooked notes
log.body: Play the third note. The teacher scoots over. By the bell, the two of you have written a fourth note.

log.title: Feeling unwell
log.body: You developed a lingering cough. You can visit the doctor in Activities.

log.title: One hand on the seat
log.body: Say the word. The hedge catches you at the end. Before that, for twelve whole seconds, you fly.

log.title: A suspiciously fast snail
log.body: Make it a tiny cheering section. Your snail finishes last. Your supporters win a completely unofficial noise contest.

log.title: Feeling better
log.body: Your symptoms from a lingering cough cleared up.

log.title: A seat on the school council
log.body: Campaign for the seat. Your speech about the lunch line gets a genuine cheer.

log.title: A small moment
log.body: You and Cleo invent a handshake so long you need a rehearsal.

log.title: A table of your own
log.body: Start a zine. Issue one is four folded pages. Cleo asks you to sign the first copy.

log.title: The night before
log.body: Revise with Cleo. You invent terrible rhymes for all the hard bits. A few actually stick.

log.title: A message before the exam
log.body: Stick to your notes. You walk into the exam with a clear head.

log.title: Two ways to spend Saturday
log.body: Work Saturdays at the café. Your apron smells like cinnamon. You take the Saturday café job. Your wages arrive on your next birthday.

log.title: Part-time payday
log.body: Saturday café paid you $460 for the year.

log.title: A small moment
log.body: A song on the bus becomes the soundtrack to the entire summer.

log.title: Part-time payday
log.body: Saturday café paid you $460 for the year.

log.title: Three envelopes
log.body: Accept the scholarship. Your tuition is covered. You pack light and leave room for books.

log.title: The stall next door
log.body: Invent a queue system. By the time the vendor returns you have a queue, a sales record and a thank-you tip.

log.title: A small moment
log.body: A postcard from out of town spends the year on your fridge.
